title: Abu Dhabi
style: Chamber punk-rock, roomy string-ensemble production with a restrained room mix; deliberate, unhurried pulse; husky, smoky, hushed close-mic male baritone; baritone saxophone answering distorted electric guitar, bass, and tight drums.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In Abu Dhabi
we booked two rooms,
we only used one.
You feared the doom;
I gave you my hand.

[Verse 2]
Slow capital—
that's what you wanted.
That was surely my offer.
Your mind was haunted
by the size of the coffer.

[Chorus]
Xumi,
I told you I trust you.
You want this, you know.
Slow capital under you—
you can make it flow.

[Verse 3]
Then you said,
"Promise me something, Thomas:
you'll never be my boss."
I got you and said, "I promise.
That'll be clear between us."

[Verse 4]
A promise in bed
in a fancy hotel room—
that's an honest deed
with blood and a plume,
just to keep you freed.

[Chorus]
Xumi,
I told you I trust you.
You want this, you know.
Slow capital under you—
you can make it grow.

[Bridge]
I won't be your boss.
I won't be your supervisor.
You'll get control of your life.
I'll keep my friend with benefits.

[Chorus]
Xumi,
I told you I trust you.
You want this, you know.
Slow capital under you—
you can make it glow.

make it glow
